research.title: Probability Calibration Under Missing Covariates
bullets: Formulated a research question on calibration under changing missingness patterns and led development of a missingness-conditioned probability recalibration method.
Evaluated calibration error and predictive loss under simulated missingness shifts, comparing pooled recalibration with pattern-specific estimates using shared regularization.

research.title: Adaptive Robust Regression With Heteroscedastic Noise
bullets: Investigated how residual scale variation affects robust regression and led development of a scale-adaptive Huber loss fitting procedure.
Compared adaptive and fixed-threshold estimators under contaminated noise distributions, examining prediction error, residual behavior, and sensitivity to scale estimation.

research.title: Stable Conformal Prediction Under Covariate Shift
bullets: Formulated questions about unstable importance weights in conformal prediction and led development of a regularized density-ratio weighting procedure.
Evaluated coverage and interval width across controlled covariate shifts, separating effects of weight regularization, density-ratio estimation, and calibration sample composition.

Regularized Density-Ratio Weighting for Conformal Prediction Under Covariate Shift

work.title: Batch Data Validation and Import Maintenance
bullets: Implemented assigned validation checks for batch data imports, handling missing fields, inconsistent types, and duplicate records within existing processing routines.
Added regression tests for reported import failures and documented error-handling behavior to support maintenance of the existing data processing service.

projects.title: Comparative Evaluation of Regularized Linear Classifiers
bullets: Implemented logistic regression with ridge and lasso penalties, using standardized features and nested cross-validation to compare regularization choices.
Compared predictive loss, coefficient stability, and feature selection behavior across datasets with correlated predictors and varying class imbalance.

projects.title: Kernel and Neighbor Methods for Nonlinear Regression
bullets: Implemented kernel ridge regression and nearest-neighbor regression, tuning bandwidths, penalties, and neighborhood sizes through consistent cross-validation procedures.
Compared prediction error and computational demands on synthetic nonlinear functions, examining sensitivity to irrelevant features and uneven sampling density.

projects.title: Bootstrap Confidence Intervals for Skewed Data
bullets: Implemented percentile, basic, and bias-corrected bootstrap confidence intervals for mean estimation, following established resampling procedures and checking reproducibility.
Compared empirical coverage and interval width in simulation experiments with skewed distributions, documenting sensitivity to sample size and extreme observations.
